name: Nadia Figueroa
title: Shalini and Rajeev Misra Presidential Assistant Professor
department: Mechanical Engineering and Applied Mechanics; secondary appointments in CIS and ESE; GRASP Lab
fitReason: Excellent CS/AI-method and physical-robot overlap: point-cloud policies, flow matching, data-efficient imitation, learned symbolic skills and reactive manipulation. The lab connects learned representations and policies to contact-rich execution, rather than focusing solely on hardware or biomechanical measurement.

physicalEvidence.summary: The April 2026 full primary version of Flow with the Force Field learns a point-cloud/force-conditioned flow-matching policy from synthetic data generated from one simulation demonstration, then deploys it on real Franka robots for block flipping and bimanual object movement. Methods specify joint-torque force estimates and a RealSense L515. Current lab facilities independently inventory Franka and KUKA arms, bimanual systems, a kitchenette, mobile robots and sensing. SymSkill, revised June 2026, also reports Franka manipulation learning from five minutes of play data; motion capture and a webcam support its learning setup.

shortVisit.summary: The full current Joining page says application information will be posted soon; it gives no current visitor application route. The lab roster includes visiting PhD researchers and a summer 2026 external undergraduate visitor, but this is precedent only. Internal robotics master's students labeled interns must not be treated as proof of external master's eligibility.

scoreReasons.fit: direct high-overlap robot-learning/perception, imitation and human-centered physical interaction.
scoreReasons.physical: full recent Penn-affiliated Franka deployment plus current local inventory.
scoreReasons.freshness: dated April/June 2026 primary versions and current 2026 lab activity. Provisional evidence-fit score, not acceptance probability or prestige.
